credit.q: What is a credit, and how much does a question cost?
credit.a: Credits are how MultiAI counts AI use. 1 credit is BDT 0.01. Every question shows its cost before you send it, and asking more AIs costs more.

failed.q: Why didn’t one of the AIs answer?
failed.a: Sometimes a model is busy or takes too long. You are not charged for an answer that fails, and you can retry that AI on its own.

bkash.q: My bKash payment failed. Was I charged?
bkash.a: No credits are taken for a failed payment. If money left your bKash account, it comes back automatically within 3 working days. If it doesn’t, chat with us.

bangla.a: Yes. Ask in Bangla or English, whichever you like. The app language only changes menus and buttons.

delete.q: How do I delete a chat or my account?
delete.qShort: How do I delete a chat?
delete.a: Open the chat’s menu and choose Delete. To delete your whole account, go to Settings › Profile › Delete account.
